title: assertType
description: You can use this function as an alternative for expectTypeOf to easily assert that the argument type is equal to the generic provided.

entries.name: assertType
entries.description: You can use this function as an alternative for expectTypeOf to easily assert that the argument type is equal to the generic provided.
signatures:
import { assertType } from 'vitest'

function concat(a: string, b: string): string
function concat(a: number, b: number): number
function concat(a: string | number, b: string | number): string | number

assertType<string>(concat('a', 'b'))
assertType<number>(concat(1, 2))
// @ts-expect-error wrong types
assertType(concat('a', 2))

examples.code:
import { assertType } from 'vitest'

function concat(a: string, b: string): string
function concat(a: number, b: number): number
function concat(a: string | number, b: string | number): string | number

assertType<string>(concat('a', 'b'))
assertType<number>(concat(1, 2))
// @ts-expect-error wrong types
assertType(concat('a', 2))

notes: WARNINGDuring runtime this function doesn't do anything. To enable typechecking, don't forget to pass down --typecheck flag.
